04 / Before you go

Good to know.

Where are my tickets?

All the passes you buy are linked to the phone number you used at checkout. Visit My tickets to find them. This isolated preview provides a local demonstration of that flow.

Who am I booking with?

Each experience has its own page, run by the organiser, venue, or reserve. Start with Bandipur Tiger Reserve or discover Veda Nāda.

What if my plans change?

Cancellation terms depend on the experience and organiser. Read the cancellation and refunds policy and the organiser’s policy before booking.

I run experiences. Can I join?

Yes. See how EN3 works for partners, try the fee calculator, and explore your own branded page, ticketing, counter, and check-in tools.
